declared_cases.note: Serious = at least one section in the case carries a maximum sentence of 5+ years. Counted: 9 PMLA (money-laundering, Section 4, max 7yr) cases and 11 CBI corruption cases (IPC 409/420/468 and/or Prevention of Corruption Act charges, each max 5-7yr+). The remaining 9 cases (defamation, minor IPC, Representation of People Act Sec 125, a traffic offence, etc.) top out under 5yr. All 29 cases show 'Charges Framed: No' and zero convictions on the affidavit.
